components.name: Button
components.description: Page-colored pill with an ink border that inverts when pressed and is dotted when disabled.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1.5px solid #173a5e; border-radius: 22px; background: #fafcfb; color: #173a5e; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease-out, transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #fff; } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { background: #173a5e; color: #fafcfb; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8553f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { color: #7f97a8; border-color: #c6d8dc; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(23,58,94,.16) 1px, transparent 1.4px) 0 0 / 6px 6px, #eef4f4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Go Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen.
components.css: .ds-go { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 26px; background: #c8402c; color: #fff; font: 600 17px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-go:hover { background: #b53824; } .ds-go:active { background: #93301f; } .ds-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8553f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Resident Row
components.description: A creature living in the pool, with a plain reason and a mood chip.
components.css: .ds-res { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 7px 14px; min-height: 52px; width: 340px; text-align: left; border: 0; background: #fafcfb; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #173a5e; } .ds-res .pt { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(95,177,201,.28); } .ds-res small { color: #3d5f7c; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-res .mood { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 11px; background: #f8dfd9; color: #9a2f1f; }

components.name: Guide Pips
components.description: Three observation pips under a guide entry: found, settled, watched.
components.css: .ds-pips { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-pips i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #3d5f7c; display: block; } .ds-pips i.on { background: #3f7a52; border-color: #3f7a52; }

narrative.overview: Tide Pool is a painted rock pool beside a field journal. The scene is watercolor washes; the journal is a pale ruled page in plain sentences, with Latin names in italic.
keyCharacteristics: Watercolor pool with pigment at the rim
Tide as a band across the whole scene

rules.name: Coral is attention
rules.body: Coral marks the action to press or the thing selected, never decoration.

rules.name: Green is observed
rules.body: Kelp green only means found, settled or watched.

rules.name: Paint, not shadows
rules.body: Depth in the scene comes from washes; the journal has none.

dos: Write states as a naturalist's sentences
Design absence with ghost entries and empty pips
